en.free_percentage: Free testosterone as a percentage of total
en.formula_note: Albumin molecular weight 66,500 g/mol; albumin association constant 3.6×10⁴ L/mol; SHBG association constant 1.0×10⁹ L/mol. No reference-range classification is applied.
en.source_reference: Calculation source: Vermeulen et al., JCEM (1999), PMID 10523012, DOI 10.1210/jc.84.10.6079.
en.guideline_reference: The Endocrine Society notes calculated free testosterone may be used when indicated, but ranges vary by method and assay; this tool does not interpret laboratory results.

ar.formula_note: الكتلة الجزيئية للألبومين 66,500 g/mol؛ ثابت ارتباط الألبومين 3.6×10⁴ L/mol؛ ثابت ارتباط SHBG ‏1.0×10⁹ L/mol. لا تصنف الأداة النتيجة وفق مجال مرجعي.
